system.purpose: Run a list of typed tasks and report the outcome.

SMS.model: src/SMS/model.js — task result, run report, the handler and reporter interfaces
SMS.registry: src/SMS/registry.js — how TMS modules are made present
SMS.runner: src/SMS/runner.js — the loop, permission check, trace emission

SCL.permissions: src/SCL/permissions.js + permissions.json — per-type limits the runner enforces

TMS.reporters/text: human-readable render of a run report
TMS.reporters/json: machine-readable render of the same report

DMS.trace: src/DMS/trace.js — run events, plus the human view of skips and refusals

dependency_rule: TMS may import SMS. No TMS imports another TMS. Checked mechanically by scripts/build-mssp.mjs.
notes: FMS is metadata only. No procedure lives in this file, and nothing at runtime reads it — it exists so a person or an agent can locate a capability without loading it.
